description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'ModelMenuAction' with nested static class 'SetField', used for modeling menu actions and setting fields within a widget framework in Apache OFBiz. It includes methods for reading sub-actions and executing set actions, handling context, session, and application scope variables.

classes.name: ModelMenuAction
classes.description: Abstract class representing a menu action with static method to read sub-actions.

classes.name: SetField
classes.description: Nested static class extending AbstractModelAction, modeling a 'set' action to assign values to fields within different scopes.

methods.name: readSubActions
methods.description: Reads sub-actions from XML elements and returns a list of ModelAction objects.
